cheryl.summary: Navi Mumbai cosmeceutical R&D + contract manufacturer with a dermatological focus.

signals.oneLine: Innovation-driven formulation & contract manufacturer in the dermatological / cosmeceutical segment (private-label, ready-to-market). No major public developments recently.

ngelectro.summary: NG Electro Products raised Rs 150 crore from JM Financial India Growth Fund III to expand manufacturing across consumer goods, personal care and nutraceuticals.

news.title: NG Electro Bags Rs 150 Cr to Fuel Expansion in India's Booming Consumer Market
news.oneLine: Rs 150 crore raised from JM Financial fund to scale manufacturing and expansion.

samrvir.summary: Samrvir Biotech is the PETITIONER in an NCLT insolvency case (C.P.(IB)/188/ND/2025, filed Mar 2025, pending) against its counterparty Clensta International Pvt Ltd — i.e. it is pursuing recovery of dues, not itself under insolvency.

signals.oneLine: Petitioner in IBC case C.P.(IB)/188/ND/2025 vs Clensta International (recovery of dues, pending).

EPL Limited.summary: Indorama Ventures took a 24.9% stake from Blackstone in May 2025 and the firm won national quality and tube awards.

news.title: Indorama Ventures Expands in Indian Market with 24.9% Stake in EPL
news.oneLine: Indorama Ventures bought 24.9% EPL stake from Blackstone, closed 27 May 2025.

news.title: EPL Nalagarh site wins IMC Ramkrishna Bajaj National Quality Excellence Award 2024
news.oneLine: World's largest tube plant received national quality performance excellence award.

Manjushree Technopack Limited.summary: Ownership in flux — Advent is selling Manjushree to PAG for ~$1bn, which shelves its planned ₹3,000 cr IPO.

news.title: Advent agrees to sell Manjushree Technopack to PAG for close to $1 billion
news.oneLine: US PE firm Advent (owner since 2018) exits to PAG at ~$1bn enterprise value — PAG's largest India deal to date.

news.title: Manjushree Technopack IPO was on the fast track — ₹3,000 cr (₹2,250 cr OFS + ₹750 cr fresh)
news.oneLine: IPO plan now overtaken by the PAG sale; FY24 revenue ₹2,130 cr, capacity ~1.9 lakh tonnes/yr.

news.title: PAG to acquire Manjushree Technopack
news.oneLine: Confirms PAG's buyout of India's largest rigid-plastic packaging maker.

signals.oneLine: Advent → PAG (~$1bn). A fresh PE owner will push hard for returns — expect cost discipline and pricing pressure; the ownership transition is a window to lock terms.

Pragati Glass & Industries Pvt. Ltd.summary: The company plans to expand capacity to one billion bottles a year with a new Gujarat plant starting 2026, riding cosmetic-industry growth.

news.title: Pragati Glass targets a billion bottles annually as India upgrades
news.oneLine: Expanding from 700M to 1B bottles yearly; new Gujarat facility begins 2026.

SICON PACKS PRIVATE LIMITED.summary: Sicon Packs achieved GMI print certification and is investing in a new Orthotec FLX3028 flexographic press.

news.title: Sicon Packs Pvt Ltd: Raising the Bar in Sustainable, High-Performance Labeling
news.oneLine: Achieved GMI certification and investing in new Orthotec FLX3028 flexo press

givaudan.summary: Global flavours & fragrances leader; made its biggest-ever India plant investment and keeps expanding across Asia.

news.title: Givaudan lays foundation for a new savoury-flavours facility in Nantong, China
news.oneLine: Continued Asia-Pacific capacity expansion strengthening regional production.

signals.oneLine: Invested ~CHF 55m in its Indian plant (biggest India commitment since 1998) — a growing local operation that needs volume to fill capacity; leverage for volume-linked pricing.

kayceeenterprise.summary: Could not confirm identity of a specific Indian cosmetics/chemicals supplier named 'kaycee enterprise' (multiple unrelated 'Kay Cee' chemical firms exist); no news.

nirmaancosmetic.summary: Identity confirmed as a Mumbai cosmetic raw material firm incorporated March 2025, but too new with no significant news found.

signals.oneLine: Established aroma-chemicals and fragrance maker with in-house R&D; a recognised industry supplier. No major public developments in recent months.

valuetree.summary: Acquired by Dutch distributor IMCD (Jan 2024) — now part of a global specialty-ingredients group.

news.title: IMCD acquires Indian beauty-ingredients distributor Valuetree
news.oneLine: IMCD buys Valuetree (FY23 revenue ~₹440 cr / €48m, 44 staff); distribution spans India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, China, Indonesia, Pakistan, Nepal.

signals.oneLine: Now IMCD-owned (IMCD is the 70% holder in its filings). A global parent brings deeper pockets and principal ties — but also group margin targets; test their pricing flexibility.

yashamspecialityingredientspvtltd.summary: Specialty-ingredients distributor & manufacturer (since 1997) across pharma, personal care, food & nutraceuticals.

signals.oneLine: Techno-commercial distributor bringing global principals to India (Mumbai HQ + Delhi & Bangalore). Keeps a low public-news profile — the leverage sits in its financials, not headlines.
